product_scope: Independent deterministic state-assurance runtime derived from Year-1 technical work; not the five-year engine program.

classes.core_mandatory: Must be implemented inside the canonical D-Core library without violating canonical authority.
classes.product_module_mandatory: Must be delivered by an official one-way companion module or tool to satisfy the product contract.
classes.host_responsibility: Must be supplied or orchestrated by the embedding process under a documented contract.
classes.deployment_responsibility: Must be supplied by the operational environment or infrastructure.
classes.native_qualification: Implementation may be ready, but the claim requires execution on designated physical hardware.
classes.external_assurance: Requires an independent auditor, certification body or external legal/technical authority.
classes.optional_vertical: Belongs to a separately licensed sector adapter and is not required to complete the horizontal D-Core product.
classes.accepted_boundary: A deliberate product boundary that is documented and tested as a boundary rather than implemented internally.
classes.out_of_scope: Not part of the D-Core product; public material must not imply that it is provided.
